text_ru: Утечка продуктов: {tons} т. Основное место утечки: {place}. Перевезите продукты под охрану.
context: Строка в списке ламп о потерях продуктов из хранилищ, где нельзя поставить сторожа. Показывает общую массу потерь и место наибольшей утечки, затем предлагает перевезти продукты в охраняемое хранилище. Это хозяйственное предупреждение, не обвинение человека и не предупреждение о суде.
meaning: Food was lost from stores that cannot be guarded; the event supplies a loss amount and the store with the greatest loss
intent: Show the measured loss and the largest-loss location, then name moving food under guard as the existing lever
keep: No named culprit; no audit or trial threat; do not suggest posting a guard at the church or clamp; largest-loss store is not necessarily the source of the entire amount
binding_note: Accepted event seam audit_unguarded_leak. tons = event amount in grams divided by 1000000 exactly once, formatted for Russian locale with sufficient precision to keep a positive loss nonzero; no extra weight suffix because text already supplies т. place = localized nominative display label for event unit (largest-loss store): церковь or бурт у <localized field name in required case>. Supply the complete label without adding another preposition in this string. resource identifies the most-lost food, not necessarily the only food; deliberately not substituted. Proposed feed key follows journal-event convention; UE may reuse this one string in the lamp list without creating a second alarm or an order button. Boss registers/imports; UE binds selection and formatting. No cadence or aggregation period invented.
